description: Compares two captures of the same page that scan_page wrote, with no browser needed. Two Markdown files are compared a passage at a time and the answer carries the changed lines and a unified diff; two PNGs are compared pixel by pixel and the newer one is written again with the changed regions outlined. For PDFs, scan with markdown "beside" and pass the PDFs or their .md files. "section" limits a text comparison to one section by its heading. "changed" says whether anything did.

newPath.description: The newer capture of the same page, of the same kind.

oldPath.description: The older capture: a .md from markdown "beside" or "only", a PNG, or a PDF with its .md beside it.

outputPath.description: For two PNGs, where to write the newer one with the changed regions outlined. Defaults to beside it, as <name>.diff.png.

section.description: For Markdown, compare only the section under this heading, or under a path of headings ("Pricing > Pro"), so banners and rails around it do not count. A section only one capture has is a change; one neither has is an error that lists their headings.

name: diff_captures
title: Say what changed between two captures
